#Blueface Recently Came Back Into Chrisean’s Life, & He’s Already Taking Initiative To Get Baby Chrisean The Help He Needs After 3 Years 🥹💯

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Michael Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper who became one of the most recognizable figures in West Coast hip-hop after breaking out in 2018. His unusual, off-beat flow helped “Respect My Cryppin’” go viral, but his biggest mainstream record became “Thotiana,” which reached No. 8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and later received remixes featuring YG and Cardi B. He released his debut studio album Find the Beat in 2020 and has continued releasing music, including new singles in 2026. 

Outside of music, Blueface became a major social-media and reality-TV personality. A large part of that attention has surrounded his highly publicized relationship with Chrisean Rock. The two met through Blueface’s Blue Girls Club project, and Chrisean was eventually signed to his BluefaceLLC label. They later became a couple and starred together on Zeus Network’s Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love. 

Chrisean Rock, born Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is a Baltimore-raised rapper, reality-TV personality and social-media figure. Before becoming famous in entertainment, she was an athlete and attended Santa Monica College as a student-athlete. Her profile grew considerably after appearing on Blueface’s Blue Girls Club. 

Chrisean later developed her own following through music and reality television. She released “Lonely” with Blueface in 2020 and followed it with “Vibe.” She became especially well known through Zeus Network’s Baddies and later Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love. Blueface and Chrisean have a son together, born in September 2023, and their relationship and family life have remained heavily discussed online. 

Blueface and Chrisean’s connection has gone through several breakups, reconciliations and highly publicized disagreements over the years. Recent 2026 reporting says they have once again been appearing together publicly, including on livestreams.
